---
title: "Exploring Storms"
author: "Jackgreer07"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
storms |>
  filter(status %in% c("tropical depression", "tropical storm", "hurricane")) |>
  mutate(status = factor(status, levels = c("tropical depression", "tropical storm", "hurricane"))) |>
  group_by(year, status) |>
  summarise(named_storms = n_distinct(name), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = named_storms, fill = status)) +
  geom_area() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "tropical depression" = "lightblue",
      "tropical storm" = "orange",
      "hurricane" = "darkred"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Named storms per year by storm type",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of named storms",
    fill = "Storm Status"
  )
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
storms_recent <- storms |>
  filter(year >= 2000) |>
  select(year, name, status, wind, pressure)
```

```{r}
storms_recent |>
  ggplot(aes(x = wind, y = pressure, color = status)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Atmospheric Pressure vs. Wind Speed in Recent Storms",
    subtitle = "Stronger wind speeds are associated with lower atmospheric pressure (2000–present)",
    x = "Wind Speed (knots)",
    y = "Atmospheric Pressure (millibars)",
    color = "Storm Status"
  )
```
